university.name: Anglia Ruskin University
university.summary: University with campuses in Cambridge, Chelmsford, Peterborough and Writtle, plus a separate ARU London campus. It admits international students to undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees, with several Master's courses starting in September, January or May. It publishes Pakistan entry requirements on its South Asia page and runs an embedded international college.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor, Student route, rated Student Sponsor (Track Record) (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time, or 4 years with a placement year
courses.overview: Three year computing degree taught at the Cambridge campus, covering programming, computer systems, software principles and operating systems in the first year, with an optional placement year normally taken as the third year.
courses.academic_requirements: Course page did not show course-specific grades. ARU Pakistan guidance for year 1 bachelor's entry: minimum 70% in grade 12, or 50% in a 2-year bachelor's degree; a recognised foundation programme, IB Diploma or International A Levels are also listed.
courses.english_requirements: ARU undergraduate standard: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 80 (17 Writing and Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking); PTE Academic 60 with 59 in each skill; Duolingo 110 with 100 in each skill (accepted where in-person tests are unavailable).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: ARU South Asia page (Pakistan section): minimum 70% in grade 12 or 50% in a 2-year bachelor's degree for year 1 entry. ARU strongly recommends that applicants from Pakistan apply through an approved agent.
courses.career_notes: Optional placement year adds a year of work experience; placement year fee GBP 1,700 (2026/27 figure).
courses.application_deadline_note: ARU accepts applications while places and time for deposit, CAS and visa remain. For September 2026 the CAS issuing deadline for Pakistan was 10 July 2026; September 2027 dates not yet published.
courses.notes: Course page states GBP 19,750 for international students starting 2027/28 (GBP 18,400 for 2026/27). The with-placement listing shows GBP 18,825 for 2027/28, which differs from the standard route figure. A GBP 4,000 deposit or sponsorship letter is required for international applicants (shown on other ARU course pages). English figures taken from https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/entry-requirements because the course page did not render them.

courses.title: Law
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time, or 4 years with a foundation year
courses.overview: Qualifying law degree route taught at Cambridge, Chelmsford and Peterborough, covering constitutional, contract and criminal law and the English legal system in the first year, with an optional legal work experience module and law clinic volunteering.
courses.academic_requirements: Course page did not show grades for the 3-year route. ARU Pakistan guidance for year 1 bachelor's entry: minimum 70% in grade 12, or 50% in a 2-year bachelor's degree. Foundation year route: 5 GCSEs at grade D or 3 or above plus two years of post-GCSE Level 3 study (or equivalent).
courses.english_requirements: ARU undergraduate standard: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 80; PTE Academic 60 with 59 in each skill; Duolingo 110 with 100 in each skill. Foundation year route: IELTS 5.5 (Academic) or equivalent.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: ARU South Asia page (Pakistan section): minimum 70% in grade 12 or 50% in a 2-year bachelor's degree for year 1 entry.
courses.career_notes: Law clinics offer supervised volunteering with qualified solicitors.
courses.application_deadline_note: Start dates may vary by campus. ARU accepts applications while places and time for deposit, CAS and visa remain.
courses.notes: Course page states GBP 18,825 for international students starting 2027/28 (GBP 17,500 for 2026/27), the same for the 3-year and foundation year routes. Page also mentions distance learning availability. English figures for the 3-year route taken from https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/entry-requirements.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (12 months for September starts, 20 months for January starts); 2 years with Professional Experience
courses.overview: Taught Master's at the Cambridge campus for graduates with programming and database experience, covering machine learning, semantic data technologies, web solutions and cyber security, ending in a major project. A two year Professional Experience route adds placements or project work.
courses.academic_requirements: Course page did not show a degree class. ARU general postgraduate requirement: typically a UK honours degree at lower second class (2:2) or equivalent. Working knowledge of databases and programming (Java, C# or Python) is strongly recommended.
courses.english_requirements: ARU postgraduate standard: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 88 (17 Writing and Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking); PTE Academic 61 with 59 in each skill; Duolingo 120 with 100 in each skill (accepted where in-person tests are unavailable).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: ARU South Asia page (Pakistan section): 4-year bachelor's degree with an overall average of 55% or GPA 2.5 (50% from the University of Punjab), or a 2-year Master's following a 2-year bachelor's on the same terms. The page does not state the GPA scale. A recognised pre-Master's course is also accepted.
courses.career_notes: Professional Experience route includes either professional placements or campus-based professional projects in the second year.
courses.application_deadline_note: ARU accepts applications while places and time for deposit, CAS and visa remain.
courses.notes: Course page states GBP 20,925 per year for international students starting 2027/28, the same for the Professional Experience route, plus GBP 4,600 (2027/28) for Professional Experience modules. A GBP 4,000 deposit or sponsorship letter is required. Degree class and English figures taken from https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/entry-requirements because the course page did not render them.

courses.title: International Business
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (12 months September, 16 months January, 20 months May starts); 2 years with Professional Experience
courses.overview: Taught Master's at Cambridge and Chelmsford covering international management, supply chain strategy, finance for decision making, international marketing and leadership, ending in a major project. A Professional Experience route adds a second year of projects or placement.
courses.academic_requirements: Course page did not show a degree class. ARU general postgraduate requirement: typically a UK honours degree at lower second class (2:2) or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: ARU postgraduate standard: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill; TOEFL iBT 88; PTE Academic 61 with 59 in each skill; Duolingo 120 with 100 in each skill.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: ARU South Asia page (Pakistan section): 4-year bachelor's degree with an overall average of 55% or GPA 2.5 (50% from the University of Punjab), or a 2-year Master's following a 2-year bachelor's on the same terms. The page does not state the GPA scale.
courses.career_notes: Professional Experience route offers professional projects, work placement or work experience modules of about 12 weeks each.
courses.application_deadline_note: May starts for the Professional Experience route are offered in Chelmsford only.
courses.notes: Course page states GBP 20,925 per year for international students starting 2027/28, plus GBP 4,600 (2027/28) for Professional Experience modules. Degree class and English figures taken from https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/entry-requirements because the course page did not render them.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Lower award up to GBP 5,000 (GBP 2,000 in year 1, then GBP 1,000 a year); Higher award up to GBP 7,000 (GBP 4,000 in year 1, then GBP 1,000 a year)
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for new international fee payers starting a full-time taught bachelor's degree at Cambridge, Chelmsford, Peterborough or Writtle. The level depends on the strength of the application, and later-year amounts require successful completion of each year.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer; new to ARU; full-time taught undergraduate course at a core campus. Higher award requires exceeding minimum entry requirements. Excludes ARU College, foundation degrees, online learning, apprenticeships and placement years.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application; awarded once all conditions of registration are met.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state the academic year or intakes it covers. Students joining in year 2 or 3 receive GBP 1,000 a year. Writtle students receive the Lower award year 1 amount automatically. Cannot be combined with other scholarships; may be sponsor-restricted.

scholarships.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 4,000, depending on qualifications
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for international postgraduate students who are studying an MBA or are ARU graduates and who exceed the minimum entry requirements.
scholarships.criteria_text: Studying for an MBA or an ARU graduate; must exceed the minimum entry requirements and meet all conditions of registration. Sponsored students may be ineligible.
scholarships.notes: Page introduction refers to anyone starting a postgraduate degree, but the eligibility list says 'be studying for an MBA or be an ARU graduate', so it may not apply to MSc courses such as Computer Science or International Business for new applicants. Page does not state fee status, academic year, campuses or whether the value is per year or total.

scholarships.name: Full Payment Discount
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 off the first year's tuition when fees are paid in full before teaching starts
scholarships.summary: Discount for new students on full-time taught undergraduate or postgraduate courses who pay their first year tuition in full by the Friday before teaching begins.
scholarships.criteria_text: New student starting a full-time taught undergraduate or postgraduate course; tuition paid in full by the Friday before the start of teaching.
scholarships.deadline_note: Pay in full by the Friday before teaching starts. For September 2026 this was 18 September 2026; September 2027 date not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms published for September 2026 starters only. The important dates page says it can be combined with scholarships for 2026/27 starters, while the International Undergraduate Scholarship page says that scholarship cannot be combined and students may take the Full Payment Discount instead.
